easyPrerequisites: You control an Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Cast Relm's Sketching by paying its mana cost, targeting an Island you control.
Holding priority, activate Overloaded Mage-Ring by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, targeting the Relm's Sketching spell.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Overloaded Mage-Ring ability, targeting the Relm's Sketching spell.
Resolve the copy of Overloaded Mage-Ring's ability, copying the Relm's Sketching spell, targeting an Island you control that enters the battlefield untapped.
Resolve the copy of Relm's Sketching, creating a token copy of the targeted Island.
When the Island token enters, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Gogo.
Activate the Island token by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 4.
